title: Corrigendum for: Artificial Intelligence-Based Digital Image Analysis for Assessing Ki67, P53, and PHH3 Expression in Glioblastoma Multiforme.
authors: Devrim, Tuba; Erkilinc, Gamze; Tuncer, Saniye Sevim
journal: Journal of the College of Physicians and Surgeons--Pakistan : JCPSP
one_liner_zh: 这是一篇关于胶质母细胞瘤中Ki67、P53和PHH3表达的AI数字图像分析文章的勘误声明，仅涉及致谢遗漏，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: This is with reference to the article titled "Artificial Intelligence-Based Digital Image Analysis for Assessing Ki67, P53, and PHH3 Expression in Glioblastoma Multiforme" published in JCPSP 2026, Vol. 36 (02): 153-7. doi: 10.29271/jcpsp.2026.02.153. It is to be informed that, during the editorial process, the acknowledgment section included in the originally submitted manuscript was inadvertently omitted. Hence, the following correction may kindly be noted: CORRECTION ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: This study was supported by the Bakircay University Scientific Research Projects Coordination Unit (Project No: BBAP.2024.005).
abstract_zh: 此函涉及发表于《JCPSP》2026年第36卷（第2期）：153-7页，doi: 10.29271/jcpsp.2026.02.153，题为“基于人工智能的数字图像分析评估胶质母细胞瘤中Ki67、P53和PHH3表达”的文章。特此告知，在编辑过程中，原始投稿稿件中包含的致谢部分被无意遗漏。因此，请注意以下更正：更正致谢：本研究由巴克尔恰伊大学科研项目协调单位资助（项目编号：BBAP.2024.005）。
